settings.title: Upload your photo
settings.text: A clear, well-lit photo of one or two faces works best — the disc is round, so the closer the faces, the more of them it holds.

settings.title: Choose your scene
settings.text: Pick from our scenes — each one built as a real leaded stained glass window.

settings.title: See it in the glass
settings.text: Your free preview arrives in under a minute, already hanging in the window. Love it? Pick your size and we'll make it.

settings.question: What exactly do I receive?
settings.answer: A round disc of glass printed with your artwork, set in a gold-tone metal rim with a chain to hang it by. It's made to order, one at a time, from the preview you approve.

settings.question: Which size should I pick?
settings.answer: The 6 inch is the one most people choose — big enough that every face reads clearly from across the room. The 4 inch suits a small kitchen window, and the 10 inch makes a statement piece.

settings.question: How long until it arrives?
settings.answer: It's made to order and arrives in 5-8 days within the USA, or 2-3 weeks elsewhere, and you'll get a tracking number as soon as it goes out.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Suncatchers are available in the United States only. Elsewhere, digital portraits and posters are available, subject to the delivery options at checkout.

settings.question: Will the faces still look like them?
settings.answer: Yes. The background and clothing are built from panes of coloured glass, but the faces and hands are kept true to your photo so every person is recognisable.

settings.question: Is the preview really free?
settings.answer: Yes. Upload a photo, pick a scene, and see your suncatcher in under a minute. No payment, no sign-up, and no obligation to order.

settings.question: What if it arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Send us a photo of the item and the packaging within 14 days of delivery and we'll replace it free of charge or refund you.
